cases.label: Towns, Courtyards, Villages, Medieval/Urban Districts
required_tools_ordered: parallax world refs (>=6 stills measured into REFS.md)
W3 modular PBR MeshPart kit (15-20 pieces) + <=3 shared 1024 trims (35-70 px/st)
parallax world town step (skins, facade:true, bend, rooms, slope, yards, market, lamps:true)

forbidden_tools.why: 12+ typed building steps bypass the modular kit and produce unique non-reusable geometry that inflates the part count.
City grid layouts make uniform blocks with no variation in density, curve, or focal point.
Plain-Part box worlds (MeshPart=0) have no surface detail and read as a placeholder level.
Row lamps on town streets read as modern streetlights and break medieval/fantasy atmosphere.
>100 unique SurfaceAppearance maps exceed Roblox streaming budgets and tank load times.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: build a gothic medieval courtyard with W3 modular kit and Realistic lighting
create a market town district with facade buildings and a central square
make a village settlement with PBR MeshPart kit and proper shadow budget

cases.label: Natural Terrain, Mountains, Valleys, Rivers, Coastlines
required_tools_ordered: parallax world terrain --dem <GeoTIFF> (Copernicus GLO-30) OR --stream (river incision) + --thermal + --erosion + painter anchor (lake bed)
vetted CC0 rock/tree/cliff meshes (parallax world import, <=20k tris)

forbidden_tools.why: Noise + thermal erosion alone produces talus-angle cones with no realistic drainage or river incision.
Lollipop/primitive-part trees and rocks read as placeholder geometry with no silhouette detail.
Stylized packs in a realistic world break visual coherence — materials must match the world's reference set.
Straight-ridge wall backdrops read as a cardboard cutout instead of a real horizon.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: build a mountain valley biome with real GeoTIFF terrain and CC0 rock meshes
create a river coastline with erosion sim and MaterialVariants fetch
make a wilderness forest biome with proper terrain drainage and vetted foliage

cases.label: Combat Arena, Duel Ring, Boss Stage
required_tools_ordered: generators (spawns, cover, breakables, landmarks) with PBR MeshPart skins
parallax world check (R6 jump arc v=sqrt(2gJ), knockback room, spawn fairness, sightlines, camera clearance)

forbidden_tools.why: Guessing jump/knockback distances produces arenas where players clip walls or fall out of bounds.
Un-checked spawn traps create situations where a player spawns into a kill zone.
Judging an arena from top-down only misses camera clearance and eye-level sightline problems.

cases.label: Any Playable World >1,024 Studs Across
required_tools_ordered: generate <=2k-tri HLOD rings via kit/world/hlod.py (meshes_blender.py hlod_ring kind)
verify StreamingEnabled: true in game's default.project.json (ask owner before changing)

forbidden_tools.why: Building >1,024 st worlds without streaming cells causes catastrophic load times and memory spikes on join.
Skipping hlod.py HLOD rings means distant geometry is unculled and exceeds the render budget.

cases.label: Roads, Paths, Walls, Palisades, Rivers Turning >20°
required_tools_ordered: parallax world check (no rocks/trees on roads)

forbidden_tools.why: Sharp un-declared kinks in roads produce geometry that clips and breaks the curve gate.
Placing scatter before roads means trees and rocks overlap the road surface and must be removed later.
